Name: Wave-Drake
Source: Lyres Guide to Risk and Reward
Information: Wave-Drakes are large mountable machines that have bodies resembling drakes, but feature huge fanned tails with massive pointed stingers, and large flat wings that can encase the unit to create a shield. Both the tail and wings have spiked sections that can lay flat or protrude like a porcupine for self-defense. Their eye is a singular searchlight used by their pilots, mounted magnetically upon their backs, to search the streets from above. They often patrol the skies above the Rising Peak, climbing and leaping from their walls, but will take to the streets to hunt down lawbreakers. These vehicles of homeland security are the most iconic symbol of Wave-Sec.

“I’m glad the framebilt I’ve met have all been good people. If creatures like the wave-drakes were used for more than policing their own settlements, the rest of Retia would have a serious problem.”

Stat Blocks.title: Wave-Drake
languages: understands Common and the languages of its creator, but doesn’t speak

traits.name: Magnetic Operator
traits.description: A magnetic clamp equipped to the construct prevents its pilot from being knocked from it or pulled off of it, even if incapacitated, reduced to 0 movement, or shoved. The pilot can only be removed if they allow it or if the construct ejects them, forcing them into an unoccupied space adjacent to it.

traits.name: Searchlight
traits.description: The construct can generate a 60-foot-cone of bright light from its eye, which moves with its field of vision. It can turn this light on or off at will on its turn. It can also focus this cone into a 120-foot-long, 10-foot-wide beam of bright light until the end of its turn.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The construct attacks twice with its Claw and once with its Tail. Alternatively, it makes two Arclight Bolt attacks.

actions.name: Claw
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 13 (2d8 + 4) slashing damage.

actions.name: Tail
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 15 (2d10 + 4) bludgeoning damage plus 6 (1d10) lightning damage or 22 (4d8) + 4 piercing damage.

actions.name: Arclight Bolt
actions.description: Ranged Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, range 40/120 ft., one target. Hit: 17 (3d10) lightning damage.

bonus_actions.name: Interior Control (Pilot Only)
bonus_actions.description: The pilot either enters an armored chamber inside the construct or exits it. They can remain there, granted total cover and being completely obscured to those from the outside, until they use this action again to exit. While inside they can see through the construct’s senses, are immune to effects originating from outside (even ones that can fit through small gaps, such as fireball), and the air inside is filtered to remove harmful substances from outside. If the construct is reduced to 0 hit points, it opens this chamber to allow the pilot to exit as a safety feature.
